# Code style

- STY-001: Follow the Microsoft .editorconfig baseline at the repo root; every rule it adopts is a warning, and warnings fail the build.
- STY-002: Never use var; write the type.
- STY-003: Turn on every analyzer rule (AnalysisLevel latest-all); an opt-out needs an ADR.
- STY-006: Don't loosen a kit rule in a repo's own .editorconfig; an exception needs an ADR.
